project: Krenix — 3 × 10s Motion Graphics Ads (Omni Flash, no extend)

delivery.audio: music + SFX only — NO voice, NO narration, NO speech, NO singing
delivery.text_workflow: Generate all clips with ZERO text baked in. All Darja text is added afterwards in CapCut / After Effects. AI video models cannot render Arabic script correctly — letters will not connect and words will be reversed. This is not optional.

why_this_structure: Omni Flash gives one 10s shot with no extend, so each clip is written as a complete 10s ad: hook (0-3s) → payoff (3-7s) → brand lock (7-10s).
No clip depends on another clip's last frame. You can run any one of them alone, or cut all three into a 30s spot.
Every clip ends on the same branded end card so the three are interchangeable and the edit always lands the same way.
Prompts are deliberately short-listed to 3-4 distinct visual beats. Long multi-beat prompts are where 10s single-shot models fall apart.

global_style.type: 100% motion graphics — no live action, no real humans, no photography, no text
global_style.look: premium dark-mode 2D/2.5D vector motion design, glowing circuit lines, ember particles, soft bokeh depth, subtle film grain
global_style.brand_mark: Circuit Phoenix — a phoenix whose wings and body are drawn as glowing PCB circuit traces, mint-to-teal gradient, rising
global_style.negative_prompt: text, letters, words, captions, subtitles, typography, logos, watermark, numbers, Arabic script, Latin script, voice, narration, speech, dialogue, singing, human voice, live action, real people, faces, hands, photorealistic humans, stock footage, gold, amber, orange, letter-K logo, shaky camera, clutter, blurry, low quality

clips.prompt: 100% motion graphics, no text, no letters, no humans, no live action. Premium dark-mode vector motion design on deep void-navy background (#08121C) with a faint animated grid and drifting dust particles. Beat 1 (0-3s): dozens of small glowing blank UI cards, blank message bubbles and blank notification toasts fly in chaotically from every edge and pile into a messy tilted stack at center, overlapping and colliding, small red dots pulsing on some of them. Beat 2 (3-6s): a single wave of mint light (#5AFFD6) sweeps across the frame from left to right; everything it touches snaps instantly into a calm, perfectly aligned grid of clean teal-accented cards, each one ticking on with a small green check mark. Beat 3 (6-10s): the tidy grid dissolves upward into rising ember particles that reassemble at center into a phoenix drawn entirely as glowing PCB circuit traces — thin luminous mint-to-teal lines with small circuit nodes — wings sweeping open, then settling and holding steady, glowing softly against black with empty clean space beneath it. Slow continuous camera push-in, snappy ease-out motion, soft depth-of-field bokeh, subtle film grain, 24fps, 9:16 vertical. Audio: music and sound design only, absolutely no voice and no speech — tense ticking synth pulse with glitchy blips for the first 3 seconds, one bright cinematic whoosh on the light sweep, then a warm uplifting synth theme resolving on a single clean chime at the end.

post_production.font: Use a bold Arabic display font with real Darja-friendly shaping — Cairo Bold, Almarai ExtraBold, or Tajawal Bold. Enable RTL. Never let the editor auto-reverse the characters.
post_production.text_style: White or Krenix Mint (#5AFFD6) text, heavy weight, tight line spacing, subtle dark drop shadow or 40% dark scrim behind the text block so it stays readable over the glow.
post_production.text_animation: Fade + 20px slide up over 250ms in, fade out over 200ms. Keep it simple — the plate is already moving.
post_production.brand_lockup: Overlay the real logo asset from public/brand/krenix-wordmark-v2.png on the final 3 seconds rather than trusting the model to draw the wordmark.
post_production.safe_zones: In 9:16 keep all text between 12% and 78% of frame height — the top and bottom are covered by Reels/TikTok UI.
post_production.music: If the model's audio comes out weak, mute it and drop a single licensed track across all three clips so they cut together.

generation_notes: Paste one clip's 'prompt' per generation. Do not merge two clips into one prompt.
Paste global_style.negative_prompt into the negative field every time — 'text' and 'voice' are in there on purpose.
Set 9:16 before generating. Regenerate at 1:1 for feed placements.
If a generation drifts (adds text, adds a person, goes photoreal), regenerate rather than fixing in post — the prompts are short enough that rerolls are cheap.
All three clips end on the identical phoenix-on-black frame, so any order works and the 30s cut is seamless.
